description: This file defines a comparator class 'UserByNameComparator' used for sorting User objects in the OpenMRS system by their associated person's name attributes. It implements the Comparator interface and provides a compare method that handles null checks and delegates the comparison to 'PersonByNameComparator'.

classes.name: UserByNameComparator
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting User objects based on their person's name attributes, Serializable for object serialization.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two User objects based on their associated person's name, handling nulls by placing nulls last.
